scope: Known-source descriptive reproducibility preparation; 14 source-table rows across two editions
exposure: Both editions, selected targets and previous outputs are known to the orchestrator. This is not project-unseen evidence.

cohort.exclusions: Do not fill merged Category cells into rows. Exclude user metadata, internal paths and all nonselected cells from output. Preserve total row separately; never add total to component rows.

cohort.table_heading: Table 3.3.1(a): total filings by application type, 2024–25
cohort.exclusions: Exclude Figure 3.3.2(a), clearance rates, case narratives, names, images and unrelated pages. Division 1 context does not imply direct new filings: nearby prose describes transfers from Division 2. Preserve total separately.

output_contract.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; one object containing contract_id and ordered rows
output_contract.row_order: cohort order above, then ascending source row
output_contract.additional_fields: Exactly the edition-specific row_fields; no additional keys
output_contract.types: source_row is integer; comparison_eligible is false; quarantined is true; period_start and period_end are null; every other field is a string
output_contract.lexical_rules: Preserve case, punctuation, diacritics, thousands separators and percentage signs. XLSX uses OOXML lexical values, joining rich-text runs in order. PDF excludes layout padding; wrap breaks within a table cell become one space. Do not normalize Unicode or numbers.
output_contract.semantics: Source-defined labels and measures only. No translated ontology, denominator inference, clearance calculation, ISO date inference or cross-jurisdiction equivalence. Period labels are source context.

concordance.critical_fields: Every common and edition-specific row field, exact row count/order and source identity
concordance.comparison: Exact typed equality; null remains a critical value; populated overall excludes null; recompute counts from both sealed outputs; no fuzzy matching
concordance.source_accuracy: Separate review against the original selected cells/table; agreement alone is insufficient

execution_controls.isolation: Extractors receive only this contract and exact source editions. No prior outputs, expected values, sibling workspace, repository history or comparator differences. Bind workspace manifests before delegation.
execution_controls.seal: Hash each output before comparator access; preserve all failures without editing or reuse
execution_controls.stopping_rules: Any source-hash, scope, isolation, schema, prohibited-data, seal or critical-concordance failure terminates execution. No automatic rerun, substitution, exclusion or waiver.
execution_controls.resources: Two existing source editions, two extraction agents, one comparator and one advisory review; zero network requests
execution_controls.historical_lineages: No historical stop rule or failed lineage is superseded by this preparation freeze

acceptance: Preparation only. Review execution authority against prior stopping rules before execution. G2 work-item acceptance and maturity require separate evidence reconciliation; this contract does not assert passage, rights clearance or release.
